[EN] Always Outnumbered, Never Forgotten
[ES] Siempre en desventaja, jamás olvidado
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Even one fighter can make a difference.
[ES] Incluso un solo luchador puede marcar la diferencia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You're all the reinforcements we need.
[ES] Eres todo el refuerzo que necesitamos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm on my way."
[ES] "Ya voy en camino."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Exit through the east gate of Lumbertown and report to Prefect Drustan at Casidhe's Stand of Celestial Hills in the southeast.
[ES] Sal por la puerta este de Lumbertown e infórmale al prefecto Drustan en el puesto de Casidhe, en Celestial Hills, al sureste.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Orcan Fang
[ES] Colmillo de orcan
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill the orcans beseiging Casidhe's Stand and tear their fangs out.
[ES] Mata a los orcanes que asedian el puesto de Casidhe y arráncales los colmillos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to Drustan.
[ES] Regresa con Drustan.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "That'll teach 'em."
[ES] "Eso les enseñará."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
